scope: Linux x86-64 release component. Canonical signed Cast admitted locally, transferred through inherited anonymous Unix workload descriptor across actual exec, callback verified original bytes and identity. Additional explicit AF_UNIX rejection on the Linux canonical host-vsock entrypoint.
mode: Rust optimized release test profile. One synthetic measurement sample.
callback_after_error: A callback that applies an external effect before returning an error can repeat that effect. After positive callback the same original reader may re-emit the last receipt without a second callback.
limits: No production launcher enrollment or positive guest AF_VSOCK traffic in this component run.
Single ephemeral reader and original grant; expired unread items can block the lane until original-generation retirement.
No independent application-processing proof, crash journal, or WAN/compression measurement.
CPU timers are per original role thread; do not add overlapping intervals to wall time.
